user.title: Build a Phrase Router rule
user.description: Pick what kind of entity this rule controls, and optionally require one or more labels. Every entity of that type carrying all of the labels (in whichever area this rule applies to) becomes a target - leave the label field blank to target every entity of that type in that area instead.

area_scope.title: Which room does this apply to?
area_scope.description: "Whichever room heard it" uses the area of whatever voice satellite/device the phrase was spoken to - walk into a room and say it, and it targets that room automatically.

wordings.title: Phrases
wordings.description: Comma-separated. "Toggle" is required and is what runs if neither of the others match. "On"/"Off" are optional explicit wordings. Response on success and response when the action fails are shown here; the less-common not-found/unknown-room responses are in the section below - every response is independent and optional, and blank keeps that outcome's original behavior (Assist's default reply on success, silence on no match, the built-in "not sure which room" reply, or letting the error propagate).

more_responses.name: More responses
more_responses.description: Less commonly customized - leave either blank to keep its original behavior.

data.response_unknown_room: Response when the room can't be resolved (optional)

name.title: Name this rule
name.description: Suggested from the domain, label, and room you picked - type your own if you'd rather.

error.toggle_required: Enter at least one toggle wording.

init.title: Phrase Router options
init.description: Everything for this rule, grouped below. Expand a section to see or change it.

targeting.name: What to control
targeting.description: Pick what kind of entity this rule controls, and optionally require one or more labels.

area.name: Where
area.description: Whichever room heard it, always one fixed room, or the whole house.

fixed_area_section.name: Fixed room
fixed_area_section.description: Only used when area scope above is "Always one specific room" - ignored otherwise.
